tasks.description: Revise and record MCP plan, architecture, and dispatch artifacts after subagent audits elevated scope isolation, graph scope, and pipeline integration to blocking work.
Generate, verify, refine, and record per-worker tree classification and tree rubric artifacts before final-output grading.

Harden persistent narration memory with session/module retrieval scope, global seed semantics, patch-level provenance, stale supersession, redaction, tolerant JSONL loading, audit output, and focused tests.
Harden SQLite narration graph memory with session/module scope, defensive narrative-path validation, temporal as-of query, schema metadata, lifecycle close, and graph tests.
Integrate graph ingestion into NarrationPipeline without mutating committed runtime state, preserve public API exports, and add a runtime immutability integration test.
Update implementation plan and add an ADR documenting the non-authoritative narration memory boundary, scope model, and graph integration contract.
Capture final-output file snapshots and run tree grading feedback against the refined rubrics for each implementation group.
Run focused narration tests, offline scene regression tests, compileall, and diff checks; record a validation report with exact outcomes.
Run QA assessment for persistence, audit, retrieval, invalidation, graph query, pipeline integration, and online quota isolation.
Produce final assessment only after the run has lasted at least two hours and all required MCP artifacts, subagent evidence, tests, and residual-risk notes exist.

risk_items: Persistent memory scope filtering can accidentally hide intended seed memories; mitigation is explicit empty-scope seed semantics plus tests for cross-session isolation.
Graph supersession can corrupt cross-session history if path identity ignores scope; mitigation is session/module columns and scoped entity ids.
Pipeline graph integration must remain post-validation and non-authoritative; mitigation is an immutability test comparing SessionMapState before and after narration rendering.
Online provider tests may fail due external quota; mitigation is to separate offline regression success from quota-attributed online failure.
